description: August 22 birthday meaning: Leo or Virgo cusp, birthday number 22, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, August 22 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Leo or Virgo. In numerology the day gives birthday number 22, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: August 22 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: The 22nd of August is a true cusp: usually the final degree of Leo, but depending on birth year and time the Sun may have entered Virgo. Master number 22, the builder, kept unreduced, suits the blend of the Lion's vision and Virgo's method. This birthday is often read as someone who dreams big and then checks every detail.

On August 22 the Sun usually sits at about 29° Leo, in the third decan, where Mars is the sub-ruler alongside Sun. The Leo–Virgo cusp, around August 22 and 23, joins a fixed fire sign to a mutable earth sign. If your birthday falls here, your Sun sign is decided by the year, the time and the place of birth, since the Sun's entry into Virgo moves a little between years. Only a calculated chart can confirm it. Many people born on this border recognise both Leo's need for expression and Virgo's love of doing things properly. The combination tends to produce a performer who rehearses thoroughly, or a perfectionist with an unexpected flair for the dramatic.

sections.heading: August 22 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 22nd gives a birthday number of 22, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced. Sometimes called the Master Builder, 22 combines the 2's cooperation with the 4's practicality on a larger scale, suggesting an ability to turn big visions into working structures. Even in the secondary position of a birth day, it is given weight in numerology. People born on this day are often described as idealistic planners, capable of organising many people towards a shared goal. Pressure can come with that potential, so pacing themselves tends to matter a great deal.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one August 22 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 11 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 33.

sections.heading: Born on August 22: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: An August birthday falls in late northern summer, a season of early harvests and holidays, and in late winter for the southern hemisphere, when the first blossom starts to appear. Leo holds most of the month, with Virgo arriving around August 22 or 23. August is month 8 in numerology, associated with ambition, authority and material skill, a fitting partner for Leo's confidence. August 22 is the 234th day of the year (235th in a leap year). By August 23, 1 day later, the Sun has usually moved on into Virgo.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by August 22, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on August 22 include Deng Xiaoping (1904), Claude Debussy (1862) and Ray Bradbury (1920).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is August 22?
faq.answer: August 22 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Leo or Virgo on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Leo. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on August 22?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On August 22 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 11 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 33 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 22 for everyone born on the 22nd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on August 22?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an August 22 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on August 22?
faq.answer: August 22 is also the birthday of Deng Xiaoping (1904), Claude Debussy (1862) and Ray Bradbury (1920). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
